summary: Soldier of Fortune entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Soldier of Fortune
entries.definitive_edition: PC Platinum/GOG route with censorship and fix state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC Platinum/current build with exact patch, region, and fix state documented

primary.version: Soldier of Fortune: Platinum Edition / current GOG PC route where available
primary.why: The PC Platinum route is the best archive target for the Raven/Activision FPS, with modern fixes and widescreen/community patch state documented. Regional low-violence/censored builds and Germany availability restrictions must be labeled.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally owned PC copy, preferably the GOG Platinum Edition where available. Record source, patch/fix/SoFplus state, violence/censorship version, renderer/resolution, difficulty, multiplayer/server state, and whether Dreamcast/PS2/Linux ports were compared.

secondary.why: PC Platinum is the best capture and fix route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record regional violence version and do not merge with Soldier of Fortune II or Payback.
